page_objective: Define the approved graphic elements, pattern systems, technical overlays, and visual accents used to reinforce SIPANEL's engineering-first industrial identity.

graphic_philosophy.statement: SIPANEL graphic elements must support technical clarity, structured hierarchy, and engineering confidence — never decoration for decoration's sake.

technical_lines.description: Thin structural lines used to create engineering precision and layout discipline.
rules: Use subtle contrast.
Avoid excessive line density.
Align lines to the grid system.

orange_accent_marks.description: Small orange highlights used for technical emphasis and conversion focus.
rules: Use sparingly.
Never dominate the composition.
Reserve for important information only.

engineering_grids.description: Grid-inspired backgrounds or overlays that communicate structure and technical planning.
rules: Keep opacity low.
Do not reduce readability.
Use only where technical context is relevant.

annotation_callouts.description: Graphic labels, pointers, and markers used to explain technical details.
rules: Maximum 3 visible callouts in preview mode.
Callout labels should remain under 6 words.
Each callout must explain risk reduction or technical value.

industrial_frames.description: Structured rectangular frames used to organize images, technical previews, and proof blocks.
rules: Use simple geometry.
Avoid decorative borders.
Maintain consistent radius and spacing.

approved_patterns.name: Diagonal Industrial Line Pattern
approved_patterns.purpose: Suggest industrial movement and structural rhythm.

approved_patterns.name: Panel Seam Pattern
approved_patterns.purpose: Reference sandwich panel systems and modular construction.

approved_patterns.name: Annotation Dot Pattern
approved_patterns.purpose: Support technical callouts and engineering inspection language.

pattern_rules: Patterns must never compete with text or technical visuals.
Use low opacity on background applications.
Patterns should support SIPANEL's industrial and engineering identity.

rules: Use thin lines for technical structure.
Use thicker lines only for emphasis.
Maintain consistency across diagrams and layouts.
Avoid overly rounded playful shapes.
Maintain industrial precision.

background_treatment_rules.contrast_rule: Graphic backgrounds must never reduce readability or accessibility.

rules: Use orange markers only for critical engineering details.
Keep technical labels short and readable.
Use arrows to explain direction, flow, or risk points.
Avoid cluttered CAD-style overlays in general brand applications.
Allow more detail only in fullscreen technical views.

incorrect_usage: Using patterns as decoration without technical purpose.
Using too many orange elements in one layout.
Creating complex backgrounds that reduce readability.
Using random linework that does not align to the grid.
Applying heavy shadows, glows, or neon effects.
Using graphic elements that look like consumer tech branding.
implementation_notes: Graphic elements must support SIPANEL's engineering authority and technical readability.
Avoid decorative excess across all brand applications.
All patterns and graphic accents must be reusable, scalable, and aligned with the design token system.
Graphic elements should feel like engineering tools, not marketing ornaments.
